facebook.long_form:
Tennessee wrapped up its 2026 fall schedule with a dominant 14-1 win over Lee University on Thursday, closing out what has been an impressive exhibition run for the Volunteers.

The headline of the night belonged to freshman Bailee Shelton, who carved through the Lee lineup with 7 strikeouts across 3.0 innings, allowing just one hit. Shelton's ability to work different zones was praised by the coaching staff — and she had the team's best hard-hit ball rate allowed of any pitcher this fall.

Head coach Karen Weekly was candid after the game, saying the competition didn't challenge the Vols the way she would have preferred late in the fall. That honest assessment isn't a concern — it's a compliment to how far this roster has come. When you have Karlyn Pickens (194 strikeouts, 1.70 ERA) and Sage Mardjetko (16-3, 1.26 ERA) anchoring a rotation that also now features Shelton, the standard for competition has to rise.

For fans who want one more look before the long winter wait, the Vols have one final public intersquad: **Thursday, October 29 at 5 PM ET at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium.** It's free and open to the public.

Tennessee enters 2027 with arguably the deepest pitching staff in the SEC. The 2027 national title conversation starts here.
facebook.image_caption: Tennessee 14, Lee University 1. Freshman Bailee Shelton struck out 7 in 3.0 innings to close out the Vols' fall slate. Last chance to see them live: Oct 29 at 5 PM ET — free at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium. #Vols

If you're anywhere near the Gulf Coast today, you have one of the best fall softball events of the season at your fingertips.

LSU and Florida State are playing a two-game fall showcase at **Orange Beach Softball Stadium** in Orange Beach, Alabama. Game 1 tips off today, **Saturday October 24, at 4 PM CT**. Game 2 follows Sunday October 25 at noon CT. Admission is just **$10 cash at the gate**.

These aren't just any programs. FSU finished the 2026 regular season at **52-1** — one of the most dominant single-season records in college softball history. LSU came in at 40-19 and enters this fall with questions to answer about its 2027 roster shape.

Both programs are entering a critical off-season roster-building period. Fall showcases like this give coaches, fans, and recruiting evaluators a chance to see real competition before the winter quiets everything down. This is a rare opportunity for the public to watch two elite programs go head-to-head in a relaxed, fan-accessible setting.

Whether you're a Tigers or Seminoles fan — or just a softball fan — this is a must-watch weekend.

facebook.long_form:
The new era of Texas Tech softball gets its final report card today.

New head coach Kelsey Cottrill and assistant Traci Pendley close out their first fall with the Red Raiders this afternoon at **1 PM CT at Rocky Johnson Field** when TTU hosts Odessa College. Last fall, Tech dispatched Odessa 15-0 in 10 innings. How this year's version — dramatically overhauled through the transfer portal — performs will be a strong preview of what's to come in 2027.

The No. 1 portal class in college softball lives in Lubbock right now. Kasidi Pickering (.384 BA, 50 HR, 169 RBI over three seasons at Oklahoma) headlines a group that includes Beachum (from FSU), Heavener, Polar, and Gallaway. Returning pieces like Kailey Williams (27 HR — a program record) and first-team All-American Caylan Terry give this roster continuity alongside the new faces.

Texas Tech was a WCWS finalist in 2026. With this roster and new staff in place, the Big 12 is already circling March 12 when conference play begins.

Today's game is the last time fans see this group until spring. The Cottrill/Pendley era in Lubbock starts for real in February.

facebook.long_form:
Oklahoma Sooner fans have one more date to put on the calendar before the long winter wait.

The Sooners will host Seminole State College in their final fall exhibition on **Thursday, October 30 at 6:30 PM CT at Love's Field** in Norman. The game is free and streams live on **1oklahoma.com** — no ticket required.

If you haven't seen Kendall Wells and Haley Kavan in the same lineup yet, this is your chance. Wells had an historic 2026 season — 39 home runs, earning NFCA Freshman of the Year honors. Kavan, a two-time WCWS Most Outstanding Player, is the most decorated active player in college softball. Pitcher Jocelyn Berzon rounds out a pitching staff that makes Oklahoma a preseason top-3 national title contender.

After a Battle Series that featured packed crowds at Love's Field, the Sooners close out exhibitions with a visit from Seminole State. It's the last public look at a 2027 Oklahoma team that believes it's on a championship trajectory.

Mark your calendars: **October 30, 6:30 PM CT, Love's Field, free on 1oklahoma.com.**

facebook.long_form:
The 2028 college softball recruiting class is already historic — and we're still more than a year away from signing day.

With over **1,200 nominations** submitted to Extra Elite 100, the Class of 2028 is on track to be the largest and deepest in the history of the recruiting evaluation process. The contact period for 2028 prospects (current high school juniors) is fully open, meaning college coaches can actively recruit this class right now.

The next major ranking milestone: **Pitchers 201-300 releases Monday, October 27.**

Here's where the top programs stand right now in the 2028 class:

- **Texas** leads with No. 1 overall prospect Michaela Landers (IF) plus new commit Ainsley Morvan (4th commit)
- **Florida** has No. 2 overall Kylie Holden (C) already committed
- **Oklahoma** has locked in 5 commits, including No. 3 overall
- **Tennessee** has 5 commits highlighted by four-star pitcher Megan Kuiper
- **Florida State** added twins Keira and Kelsey Luderer

The race for the top 2028 class is one of the most compelling storylines in college softball right now. When the full EE100 drops later this season, things are going to get very interesting.
